seller_feedback.feedback_text: The item arrived as promptly as could be expected, and shipping/tracking info was provided along the way. It was very well packaged, and exactly as described (even better in some areas!). I did have a question about the item after delivery and the seller was very friendly & responsive (though I did need to figure some of it out myself, which is to be expected given the nature of the item). Overall this was a fantastic experience and I'd buy from them again!

Very well packaged product exactly as described condition was excellent and it was clear that although the box was opened nothing was used because all of the small parts were still in the sealed bag. ethical ebayer. very prompt delivery as well.

Sadly the border stopped the package, but the seller was very quick with the communication and with refunding the entire payment.
The customer care is top notch, given the chance i would surely buy again from them (hoping the border won't stop the package again)!

Beautiful looking Z590 ASUS Apex motherboard at a great price that works perfectly. The seller’s communication was excellent. The item was packed really well (double boxed) and sent through Australian Post for the Australian leg of the shipping. Very happy.

Seller had good communication. Item was exactly as described, used but good condition. Motherboard was tested as soon as it arrived. Make sure to clear CMOS if you are having any issues. Shipping time took a month but its to be expected. Good seller!

Fantastic seller, item arrived in a timely manner, well packaged and great communication. We had an issue with the item we received, but the seller went above and beyond to make us satisfied. 5 star experience and would definitely do busines with them again!
A fantastic seller, there was an issue with the shipment of my first item and they have kindly send a second item to me at no charge via UPS. Great communication throughout the process!
Excellent, fast shipping came in good condition, as described, well packed. Seller very friendly and professional, very good price /quality. Thank you! :)
